method.measure: Jaccard similarity over lower-cased source tokens
method.clean_subset_rule: Exclude every R7 evaluation case whose source Jaccard similarity to any R5/R6 evaluation source is >= 0.45.

conclusion: The pilot run is not clean held-out evidence. On the non-overlapping subset, C does not improve corruption detection over A, increases false rejections, and has lower policy accuracy. The clean evidence favors the deterministic checker. The pilot's apparent gain on E05/E08 is not eligible as unseen evidence because both cases closely paraphrase R6 cases.
